items.title: UK's CMA Launches Merger Inquiry Into Danone-Huel Deal
items.summary: Britain's Competition and Markets Authority has launched an investigation into Danone Holdings (UK)’s proposed acquisition of Huel Limited.

items.title: Spirits veteran to join UK firm Distil as CEO
items.summary: UK spirits group Distil has appointed former Diageo executive David Smith as its new CEO.

items.title: Uber’s acquisition of Delivery Hero could be finalized as early as this week
items.summary: The German food delivery company Delivery Hero has confirmed that it is in advanced talks with the American company Uber regarding a takeover bid. The two parties may reach an agreement as early as this week.

items.title: Costco Reports 10% Rise In June Net Sales As US Operations Drive Growth
items.summary: Costco Wholesale Corporation has reported a 10.6% year-on-year increase in net sales, to $29.24 billion (€25.6 billion), in June 2026

items.title: Stripe and Advent are jointly offering $53 billion for PayPal
items.summary: Payment provider Stripe and private investor Advent International are making a joint bid to acquire PayPal for more than $53 billion (€46.4 billion). If the deal goes through, a young challenger will swallow up one of the pioneers of online payments.

items.title: French Organic Food Market Grows 3.6% In FY 2025 - Agence Bio
items.summary: The French organic food market reached €12.6 billion, a 3.6% increase compared to 2024, according to a report from Agence Bio.

items.title: Nestlé Spain Converts Coffee Capsules Into Outdoor Furniture
items.summary: Nestlé Professional Spain has launched a circular economy initiative, manufacturing terrace chairs from its used capsules and coffee grounds.

items.title: Kodi’s bankruptcy filing highlights a deep crisis in the German retail sector
items.summary: Non-food discounter Kodi, which operates about 150 stores in Germany, is fighting for its survival through bankruptcy proceedings for the second time in two years. Several other German retailers are also facing tough times.

items.title: Sazerac picks Osborne for Spain distribution
items.summary: US spirits major Sazerac has picked Spanish business Osborne to distribute its products in the European country.

items.title: Capri Sun to build first factory in Poland
items.summary: Capri Sun Group is expanding its European manufacturing network by setting up its first production site in Poland.

items.title: Cotswold Outdoor owner is working to improve profitability
items.summary: Yonderland, the owner of the retail chains A.S.Adventure and Juttu in Belgium, Bever in the Netherlands, and Cotswold Outdoor in the United Kingdom, posted a slight net loss last fiscal year. The retailer is taking measures.

items.title: Swiss trade deal to open market for UK beef, lamb and dairy farmers
items.summary: UK farmers are to have improved access to the Swiss market after the UK signed a new trade deal with Switzerland, in a move welcomed by the National Farmers' Union (NFU).

items.title: Rabanne brings on Balmain creative director Olivier Rousteing
items.summary: Fashion brand Rabanne has appointed Olivier Rousteing as creative director. With the former Balmain designer, owner Puig is not only bringing in a distinctive creative vision, but also a large social media following and a proven track record in sales.

items.title: Uncle Nearest CEO fired from business by receiver

items.title: Danone expands high-protein Silk line into yogurts, shakes
items.summary: The launch comes after early success for the brand’s milk line, underscoring interest among younger consumers in plant-based options loaded with the popular nutrient.

items.title: eBay allowed to acquire Depop from Etsy after all
items.summary: On Wednesday, the British competition authority, the CMA, gave the green light for eBay's planned acquisition of the fashion platform Depop. With this approval, a major hurdle to finalizing the deal has been cleared.

items.title: The Ben & Jerry’s Foundation may cease operations
items.summary: The Ben & Jerry’s Foundation may be forced to cease its operations, as Magnum has cut off its funding and evicted the organization from its offices. The foundation is hoping for a favorable ruling in a lawsuit against the publicly traded ice cream giant.

items.title: Conagra’s new CEO ready to take ‘bold actions’ to turnaround food giant

items.title: B&M Reports Revenue Growth In Q1, Boosted By France And Heron Foods
items.summary: B&M reported an increase in revenue in the first quarter of its financial year, led by strong performance in its French unit and Heron Foods.

items.title: Carrefour Belgium shares its progress on the protein shift
items.summary: According to Carrefour, it is the first retailer in Belgium to transparently measure and disclose its so-called “protein split”—that is, the ratio of plant-based to animal-based proteins. The goal of 60% plant-based by 2030 is still a long way off.

items.title: French growth offsets British decline at B&M
items.summary: B&M posted modest revenue growth in the first quarter. In the United Kingdom, the gardening and outdoor season got off to a slow start, but growth in France and improved performance at Heron Foods offset the decline.

items.title: James Watt bids to buy back BrewDog
items.summary: James Watt, the founder of BrewDog, has tabled a bid to buy back the UK business he founded almost 20 years ago.

items.title: Essity Beats Q2 Profit Forecast As Volumes Offset Lower Prices
items.summary: Sweden's Essity reported second-quarter core earnings slightly above expectations as demand remained resilient despite cost pressures.

items.title: Crisp raises 25 million euros to scale up and expand
items.summary: Online grocer Crisp has raised 25 million euros from its existing shareholders. The Dutch company plans to use the funds to expand its operations and support further growth.

items.title: Temu “triples brand monitoring” in the fight against counterfeiting
items.summary: Temu says it is significantly stepping up its monitoring of potential intellectual property infringements. The platform now proactively monitors more than 15,000 brands—three times as many as a year ago.

items.title: The Very Group turns to AI to overhaul pricing strategy

items.title: M&S to commence Marble Arch store redevelopment works

items.summary: Tesco is testing an autonomous robot that roams supermarket aisles looking for empty shelves, misplaced products and incorrect prices.

items.title: More ready-to-eat options in renovated Jumbo Foodmarkt Utrecht
items.summary: The completely renovated Jumbo Foodmarkt in Utrecht features a more organized store layout, an even wider selection of ready-to-eat meals, an extensive sports nutrition section, and more self-checkout lanes.

items.title: Jewelry and its boutiques make Richemont shine

items.summary: Dr. Martens is sticking to its projections for this fiscal year. Sales are on track, as is the company’s goal of becoming “the most coveted premium footwear brand in the world.”
